CreditsOut.description:
A tenant's credits. ``balance`` MAY BE NEGATIVE: credits already spent
from a purchase that was later refunded / disputed are owed (ADR-0003
item 12). UIs should show a negative balance as a debt (``in_debt``,
``debt`` = credits owed), not as an error; spending is refused until
purchases cover it.

Returned only to the inviter at creation time (contains the raw token).

The token is never persisted (only its sha256) and is also e-mailed to
the invitee; this response is the only other place it ever appears.

RegistrationAcceptedOut.description:
Uniform registration response.

Identical whether or not the email already had an account, so the endpoint
cannot be used to enumerate registered addresses. The address owner gets an
email either way (a verification link, or a "you already have an account"
notice).

message.default: Registration received. Check your email to verify your address and finish setting up your account.

SSOInitOut.description:
SSO initialization output.

``binding`` ties the flow to the client that started it (login-CSRF
protection). It is also set as an HttpOnly cookie; an API/SPA client that
cannot rely on the cookie must echo it back in the ``X-SSO-Binding`` header
on the callback/link request (a cross-site link cannot set that header).
